examples.erb:
<%= ui_stack gap: :section, class: "w-full max-w-xl" do %>
  <%= ui_section title: "Recent expenses", actions: capture { ui_button("Add expense", icon: "plus", size: :sm) } do %>

        <%= ui_text "Dinner with friends" %>

          <%= ui_text "Alex Kim" %>
          <%= ui_text "Joined today", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

examples.title: Reading content
examples.erb:
<%= ui_prose do %>

Make room for the trip

A shared plan is easier to follow when each idea has room to breathe. Keep the essentials close and give a new topic a little more space.

Start with one clear decision, then choose what comes next.

  • Choose a place to stay.
  • Set aside time for a slow morning.
  • Leave an afternoon open.

The best part of a plan is the space it leaves for a surprise.

Ready to begin?

Buttons and other app controls can opt out of reading styles.

<%= ui_button "Create a plan" %>
<% end %>

examples.title: Japanese reading
examples.erb:
<%= ui_prose lang: "ja" do %>

旅の計画に、少しの余白を。

みんなで予定を考えるときは、大切なことから順番に決めていきましょう。読みやすい行間と段落の間隔が、長い文章をたどる手助けになります。

最初に決めておきたいこと

  • 集合する場所と時間
  • みんなで分ける費用
  • 自由に過ごす時間

予定が変わったら、グループにひとこと。少しの共有で、旅がもっと気軽になります。

何もしない時間も、旅の楽しみのひとつです。

<% end %>

blocks.title: Application header
blocks.description: A glass header with navigation, an account menu and room for your brand.
notes: Replace the sample brand, links and account actions with your application's content.
Keep navigation destinations as links and account actions in the menu. The header's layout and scroll behavior live in the example files.

<% [ [ "Overview", "overview" ], [ "Projects", "projects" ], [ "People", "people" ] ].each do |label, id| %> <%= ui_button_link_to label, "##{id}", variant: :ghost, size: :sm %> <% end %>
